signature: write_payload(trace_dir, event_id, name, content, binary=False) -> str
pre_condition: trace_dir is a writable directory path. event_id is a non-empty string. name is a non-empty string composed solely of characters legal in a filename on the target platform. content is a string when binary is false, or a bytes object when binary is true. binary is a boolean.
post_condition: The entire content is stored in a file within the trace payload subdirectory of trace_dir. The filename consists of event_id and name joined by a single underscore character. The write is atomic: any observer of the filesystem sees either the file absent (or in its prior state) or the file containing the complete new content; no intermediate or partial content is ever visible. Returns the relative path from the parent directory of trace_dir to the stored file, expressed with the platform's native path separator.
